title: Optical Flow
text: Estimate object velocities, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Stop iterative solution} sets Stop iterative solution When maximum number of iterations is; {Method} sets the optical flow calculation method, {Compute optical flow between} sets the compute optical flow Current frame and N-th frame, {N}, {Smoothness factor}, {Maximum number of iterations}, {Velocity output} sets the optical flow output, {Temporal gradient filter} sets the filter used for temporal gradient Difference filter, {Number of input frames to buffer}, {Standard deviation for image smoothing filter}, {Standard deviation for gradient smoothing filter}, {Discard normal flow estimates when constraint equation is ill-conditioned}, {Output image corresponding to motion vectors (accounts for block delay)} and {Threshold for noise reduction}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I/I1
ports.summary: Image or video frame scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: V
ports.summary: Velocity components in complex form scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Method
params.values: Optical flow calculation method Horn-Schunck (default) | Lucas-Kanade

params.name: Compute optical flow between
params.values: Compute optical flow Current frame and N-th frame back (default) | Two images

params.name: Stop iterative solution
params.values: Stop iterative solution When maximum number of iterations is reached (default) | When velocity difference falls below threshold | Whichever comes first

params.name: Velocity output
params.values: Optical flow output Magnitude-squared (default) | Horizontal and vertical components in complex form

params.name: Temporal gradient filter
params.values: Filter used for temporal gradient Difference filter [-1 1] (default) | Derivative of Gaussian

params.name: Number of input frames to buffer
params.values: Number of input frames to buffer for smoothing 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Standard deviation for image smoothing filter
params.values: Standard deviation for image smoothing filter 1.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Standard deviation for gradient smoothing filter
params.values: Standard deviation for gradient smoothing filter 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Discard normal flow estimates when constraint equation is ill-conditioned
params.values: Discard normal flow estimates off (default) | on

params.name: Output image corresponding to motion vectors (accounts for block delay)
params.values: Output image corresponding to motion vectors off (default) | on
